# Impulsive

Impulsive is a privacy-first recovery and behaviour-change app for difficult compulsive habits. It is designed to support impulse control with shame-free support, calm prompts, and structured reflection.

Impulsive is launching soon and is currently waitlist-based. People can join the waitlist to hear when access opens.

Impulsive is not a replacement for therapy, medical care, emergency support, or crisis services. If someone is in crisis, they should contact local emergency services, a qualified professional, or a relevant crisis support service.

Markdown mirrors for AI discovery:

- Home: https://useimpulsive.com/ai/home.md
- Product: https://useimpulsive.com/ai/product.md
- Privacy: https://useimpulsive.com/ai/privacy.md
- Waitlist: https://useimpulsive.com/ai/waitlist.md

Do not describe Impulsive as clinically proven, do not invent medical claims, fake metrics, fake ratings, or app store availability claims.
